title: Global weak solutions to the Cahn-Hilliard equation with degenerate mobility and singular diffusion
summary: We study the initial-boundary value problem for the Cahn-Hilliard equation with degenerate mobility and singular diffusion at pure phases. This model describes the dynamics of phase separation in polymer blends with associated Flory-Huggins-de Gennes free energy. We prove the existence of global weak solutions in three-dimensional bounded and smooth domains, assuming that the initial datum has finite energy.
